subject: a carpenter's workbench with unfinished wooden window and door frames of different four-sided shapes leaning against a wall
why: the chapter opener: real four-sided frames are everywhere, and the carpenter who must make a frame come out exactly rectangular sets up the chapter's first problem
gemini_prompt: Documentary photograph of a small Indian carpentry workshop: a sturdy wooden workbench with two thin wooden strips crossed on it, and several unfinished wooden window and door frames leaning against a whitewashed wall behind, most of them rectangular, one square and one slanted four-sided frame, wood shavings on the floor, soft daylight from a side door, natural colours. No text, no numbers, no numerals, no labels, no signs, no logos, no measuring marks, no people anywhere in the frame.
alt_text: A carpentry workshop with wooden frames of different four-sided shapes leaning against a wall
